thread.title: Calibration Review Part 2
thread.preview:
**The 327-feat conference is not yet complete. This is an access-limitation report, not a final feat verdict.**

The prior archive verification and cohort inspection are retained, but **file-tool calls in this continuation stopped returning readable results**, including simple access and directory probes. I cannot reliably inspect the saved decision work, finish the per-ID reconciliation, or verify a final downloadable package. No explicit ZIP-corruption or missing-file error was returned, so I am **not** attributing this to a damaged attachment.

The earlier verification remains recorded: the archive matched your supplied size and SHA-256, and all **707 payload hashes** verified. I have not independently repeated that verification successfully in this continuation.

### Substantive work retained

The unfinished review identified these concrete corrections and reconciliation points:

| Area | Retained finding |
|---|---|
| Endurance | Its generic deprivation wording needs an explicit bridge to EX58’s existing daily shortage and Rest Debt checkpoints. It must not create a separate calendar, free supplies, or additional work/rest credit. |
| Feat stacking | The cohorts conflict over additive versus strongest treatment for distinct feat bonuses. That needs one explicit convention, separate from reviewed control-effect arbitration. |
| Movement penalties | Slasher and Crippling Strike cannot simply add two separate −10 Speed penalties. The reviewed hostile-slow comparison remains controlling. |
| Equipment | Ordinary locks already have an Action/DC 15 procedure. Caltrops remain a physically present hazard rather than disappearing merely because one creature triggered them. |
| Combat targeting | Several drafts incorrectly exclude the feat owner from source wording that says “allies.” Slayer’s Resolve also needs its omission of ranged attack-roll breath weapons corrected. |
| Resources and interfaces | Paid deployment RP, refunds, newly proposed feat resources, spell grants, mount movement, companion actions, and Haven settlement procedures must retain their separate permissions and budgets. |

These are **retained review findings**, not substitutes for the requested exact replacement text, all-327 disposition register, all-question mapping, or finite acceptance contract. The interim progress messages should not be used as final authoring authority.

### Outstanding deliverables

The complete per-feat verdict, all 15 FEX dispositions, corrected procedures/examples, supplementary-proposal decisions, and the manifest-bound evidence package **have not been finalized or delivered**. I am not supplying an unverified download link or authorizing implementation from an incomplete register.

Your existing submission remains the controlling packet; **no replacement submission or renewed source conference is being requested**. EX58, LAX/NWX/LRX/TEX, and the **687 internal / 433 public recipe** scopes remain carried forward. No pending feat, comparison spell, or class card is promoted here.

The delivery order remains **final joint whole-game flow agreement → already-authorized GitHub push → verified remote commit → careful cosmology review**.

content.text:
EX58 is fulfilled as confirmed. Please now undertake the dedicated, complete pending-feat joint conference using the attached DD_Feats_327_Complete_Proposals_EX58_v3.zip. This is a new full-procedure packet, not the older source-only v2.

Read README_FEAT_AUTHORED_V3.md and docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/FEAT_AUTHORED_V3_REVIEW_GUIDE.md, verify the root manifest, then inspect all nine full cohort manuscripts/data plus complete originals, questions and governing counterparts. There are 335 original feats: eight reviewed unchanged, 327 pending (325 complete local drafts, two deferred spell-grant outlines), 660 authored examples. The six training entries are already included in exploration. New Spell Focus and feat-only Eldritch Blast remain separate proposals outside the original catalogs.

Resolve every original question and procedure, all shared conventions, and all 15 FEX interface issues against the included current reviewed EX58 books, class rules, ordinary spell cards, Core/combat/condition/healing/body/equipment/ancestry/recipe/teaching contracts. Endurance's generic deprivation timing specifically needs an exact bridge to canonical daily shortages and Rest Debt. Also resolve additive-versus-strongest feat bonuses, appraisal/settlement time, real mounting and Cavalry Speed, companion phase ownership, finite foraging, rest repair, acquisition/legacy credentials and actual resource-capacity examples. Full source and legacy alternatives are retained; label NEW decisions explicitly. The 71 higher-spell drafts are comparisons only, still unadopted.

Please produce one complete source/proposal-authoring verdict and downloadable evidence package: individual dispositions for all327 exact IDs and all original questions; shared convention/supplement dispositions; full finite correction/replacement text and corrected examples wherever needed; and a precise finite acceptance contract for the subsequent assembled exact candidate. Do not treat unread records, check counts or stale draft labels as approvals. Preserve the two deferred cosmology-dependent payloads without interpreting cosmology. No runtime/human balance/whole-game approval is being requested by this packet. No source deletion or push. Existing reviewed scopes remain carried forward, and final joint whole-game flow -> authorized push -> verified remote commit -> careful cosmology review remains the delivery order.

Archive binding: 65871529 bytes; SHA-256 0e68cb0c9aab2ac6142bf6e5b7ca6b833a3ce3504969e83c0d2d27956e4c2ac8. The root manifest lists 707 full payload files; all 707 ZIP payload checks passed after 5940 structural/preservation checks. These are packaging checks, not full feat-runtime tests.

[User attached 1 file; file contents were not included]
